about: R1b flag configurations (docs/preregistration/R1b-improved-router-planner.md). Every flag not named keeps its source default; the planner context flags come from the frozen planner protocol, as in R1.

C0.role: current source, every new flag off (control for the source drift since ARIES-FINAL-20261006)

G.role: ablation: capability gate and its planner hint only

P.role: ablation: planner grammar and OOS action only

C2.role: development round 2: capability gate, its hint and the per-capability grammar; frozen router surface, no OOS message

C3.role: development round 3: C1 without the planner OOS message

selection_rule: highest sum of nl2bash-dev top-1 (of 100) and clinc-dev act/abstain correct (of 150); C1 180, C3 177, C2 168, C0 142 (DEVLOG.md)
